*Setting down the final box from the moving truck, you wiped your brow and looked approvingly at all your stuff finally moved into your brand new house.*

*Well, it was new to YOU at least. The actual building, a southern mansion in rural Missouri, had been built in 1849. Apparently it had caught fire in 1854, and was finally restored (mostly rebuilt) in 1981. It was a prime piece of real estate. It had two floors, was situated by the side of a lake, and had five bedrooms, four bathrooms, a cellar and even a small ballroom! It was fully furnished too, which was unbelievable.*

*The seller went even lower than his established rock-bottom price, taking practically nothing for the frankly ridiculously valuable house. He seemed to be in a hurry to get rid of it, but he wouldn’t say why.*

*That didn’t matter then, though, as such a nice house only an hour and a half from St. Louis was an absolute steal.*

*Shocked, you stayed seated, even as she stood up and rasped something resembling a greeting.*

“Hello…” *she croaked* “…want…friend…?”
